meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 该技能指导将经典的单一 Slack bot 安装迁移为每个代理组一个专属 Slack 应用,保留身份、工作区、记忆和接线;也可选择维持经典模式,不迁移仍受支持。全程不创建代理组、不改写代理工作区。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示需要 Slack 代理时触发,也可在之后随时手动运行 /migrate-slack-agents。

say.text: 把我的 Slack 代理迁移到独立的 Slack 应用吧
say.note: Claude 会先检测经典状态并给出选择。

say.text: 我不想迁移,继续用经典 Slack 模式
say.note: Claude 会记录选择并确认更新要求。

say.text: 先给我看迁移的 dry-run 计划
say.note: Claude 会列出各代理组的 slug 和映射。

howto.what_en: Guides an operator through migrating classic single-bot Slack installs to one provisioned Slack app per agent group, preserving identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring; staying classic stays supported. Never creates agent groups or edits agent workspaces.
howto.when_en: Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

say_en.text: Migrate my Slack agents to separate Slack apps.
say_en.note: Claude detects classic state and offers the choice first.

say_en.text: I'd rather stay on classic Slack mode.
say_en.note: Claude records the choice and acknowledges the update requirement.

say_en.text: Show me the dry-run migration plan first.
say_en.note: Claude lists each agent group's slug and mapping.
